name: Estuary, brackish channel and sheltered lagoon water

variants.note: Muted brown-green shallows at the river mouth, deepening into a dark downstream channel with silt banks and directional ripples.
Quiet turquoise lagoon shallows around a darker sheltered basin, with gentle reflections and a clear breach to the sea.
Still dark pocket behind an anchored reed margin; broad reflected sky patches replace directional channel ripples.
Narrow brackish channel between rooted reed banks, with a visible flowing centre and dark wet soil at the reed feet.
River-to-sea mixing reach with a broadening channel and gradual silt-to-marine colour change; preserve its declared network source and outlet.

approval.note: W0 catalogue proposal for Claude review; not drawable approval, not placeable.

requires.note: Proposed W5 selector: the connected reach has declared upstream source and coastal outlet. Each channel cell need not lie next to the sea.

story.lore: Connect river mouths, Driftwood cove and Lagoon Landing to the sea without a sudden colour cut.

todo: Scope: shared. Reusable across the listed places; preserve site-specific assembly and state.
Purpose: Connect river mouths, Driftwood cove and Lagoon Landing to the sea without a sudden colour cut.

Visual brief: Muted silt or turquoise shallows over a dark shared sea body; deeper channels stay directional, with mud or sand banks and anchored reeds on the landward side. Reflect boats and quay shadows in finite local shapes.
Geometry: proposed visual envelope only; Claude supplies exact foot, solid footprint, overhang, interaction anchors and any deck after review.
Implementation: concept only, outside the live piece library. Do not place, bake or grant gameplay until reviewed and approved.
Widths: Channel 3-6+ cells; lagoon area; landward reed margins 1-2 cells.
No tidal navigation gate or new swimming is introduced; traversability follows the authored zone walk mask.
Lighting: upper-left key light; shade each material and facing for that light. The lit-picture reference is deferred until art exists.
Regional refinement: Lull/delta/Gullwick/Neon ria use the same estuarine construction, not a separately commissioned water fill. Existing inland water serves the river above the brackish reach.
Source: docs/vision/regions/neon-harbour-delta.md; former industry_brackish_channel brief consolidated here.
Widths: 2-cell backwater, 3–5-cell minor arm, 6+ navigable reach; banks and flow preserve connectivity between zones.
